newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenues rise 0.3 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenues rise 0.3 percent in April.

text.p: Georgia revenues totalled $985.4 million in April, an increase of $2.7 million or 0.3 percent over April of last year, Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said Friday.
Collections for the fiscal year to date totalled $8.7 billion, an increase of $461.4 million or 5.6 percent over the same period last year.
Sales and use taxes for the year to date rose by 2.9 percent over last year. Corporate income tax revenues rose by 4.2 percent and personal income tax revenues rose by 9.5 percent over last year.
